The most important reorganization of the Defense Department since 1947. It took operational control away from the service chiefs, ran the chain of command from the President through the Secretary of Defense to the combatant commanders, and made the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs the principal military adviser.

::: {.official-links}
**Read the law** (official GovInfo text)

[Enacted text: 100 Stat. 992](https://www.govinfo.gov/link/statute/100/992){.btn-official} [Current U.S. Code: 10 U.S.C. 151 et seq.](https://www.govinfo.gov/link/uscode/10/151?link-type=html){.btn-official}
:::

## Key provisions

- Chain of command: President to Secretary of Defense to combatant commanders, bypassing the service chiefs.
- The Chairman of the Joint Chiefs advises in his own right; the position of Vice Chairman was created.
- The services organize, train, and equip forces but do not command them in operations.
- Joint duty assignment made a requirement for promotion to general or flag rank.
- Sec. 603: requires the President's annual National Security Strategy report.

## Why it matters

It was a response to the failures of interservice coordination in the Iran hostage rescue attempt and Grenada. It amends the [National Security Act](nsa-1947.qmd) and was followed weeks later by the [Nunn-Cohen Amendment](nunn-cohen-1986.qmd). Proposals for a 'Goldwater-Nichols for the interagency' use it as shorthand for forcing joint action by statute.

## Current status

In force as amended, with notable adjustments in the FY2017 defense authorization.

## Where it sits

- **Layer.** Framework statute. Standing laws that create institutions or general procedures other laws and executive actions plug into, such as the National Security Act, the War Powers Resolution, IEEPA, and FISA. ([How the layers work](../study/index.qmd#the-authority-stack))
- **Builds on.** [National Security Act](nsa-1947.qmd), [DoD Reorganization Act (1958)](dod-reorg-1958.qmd), [Title 10 U.S.C.](title10-usc.qmd).
- **Codified in.** [Title 10 U.S.C.](title10-usc.qmd).
- **Era.** End of the Cold War ([timeline](../study/timeline.qmd)).
- **Study.** [Unit 7: Organizing and commanding the military](../study/units/defense-organization.qmd) (core reading).
- **Member lenses.** [Rep. Jason Crow](../members/crow.qmd): Armed Services.
